verse.text: Teach the older men to exercise self-control, to be worthy of respect, and to live wisely. They must have sound faith and be filled with love and patience.

video.title: Fruit of the Spirit // Self Control // 5 Minute Bible Study
video.channel: Daily Dose Daily Devotional Today with Chris Brown

reflection: A dad doesn't have to be perfect, but he does need to be steady — the kind of man whose word can be trusted and whose temper doesn't run the house. When your kids see you choose patience over blowing up, or wisdom over a quick impulsive decision, you're quietly teaching them what a godly man looks like far better than any lecture could. Self-control isn't about being rigid; it's about being the calm, faithful anchor your family can lean on.
